info.title: Airudit.MdBook – Usage
info.description: turns a collection a markdown files into a book

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: This command will generate HTML files for each specified markdown file.

options.name: --Export
options.description: Exports the generated documentation to this directory

options.name: --Single-File
options.description: Exports the generated documentation to a single file

options.name: --Side
options.description:
Also writes each page's HTML next to its source file.
These in-place files are written by default, but are
suppressed once --Single-File or --Export is given; pass
--Side to keep writing them as well.

options.name: --Template
options.description: Specifies the HTML template file path

options.name: --Version
options.description:
Prints the tool version and exits
